description: This file defines a custom PHP class 'PDF' that extends the TCPDF library to generate PDF documents with specialized features such as drawing rounded rectangles, rotating content, adding images, texts, and table structures specific to reporting or document generation within a project that uses TCPDF.

classes.name: PDF
classes.description: A subclass of TCPDF that provides additional methods for drawing shapes, formatting text, placing images, and creating structured PDF components tailored for specific reporting needs.

methods.name: RoundedRect
methods.description: Draws a rounded rectangle with specified coordinates, radius, and style.

methods.name: _Arc
methods.description: Draws an arc between three points, used internally by RoundedRect.

methods.name: Rotate
methods.description: Rotates subsequent drawing commands by a specified angle around a point.

methods.name: _endpage
methods.description: Overrides the parent class method to reset rotation at the end of a page.

methods.name: sizeOfText
methods.description: Calculates the number of lines needed to display a given text within a certain width.

methods.name: addImage
methods.description: Adds an image to the PDF at specified location.

methods.name: addCompany
methods.description: Placement of company name and address onto the PDF.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Creates a titled bubble block with a label and total count.

methods.name: addTextBlock
methods.description: Adds a non-wrapped text block with a title at a specified position.

methods.name: tableWrapper
methods.description: Draws a table wrapper with rounded corners and dividing lines.

methods.name: addBubble
methods.description: Adds a single bubble with a title and page number.

methods.name: addBubbleBlock
methods.description: Creates a bubble block with a title and page number.

methods.name: addRecBlock
methods.description: Creates a record block with a title and data.

methods.name: addDescBlock
methods.description: Adds a description block with formatted text.

methods.name: drawLine
methods.description: Draws a horizontal line at specified position.

methods.name: addCols
methods.description: Adds column headers to a table with specified positions.

methods.name: addLineFormat
methods.description: Sets the formatting for table columns.

methods.name: addProductLine
methods.description: Adds a product line (row) into a table.

methods.name: addTotalsRec
methods.description: Draws totals and summary lines in a structured block.

methods.name: watermark
methods.description: Adds a watermark text with rotation to the current page.

methods.name: StripLastZero
methods.description: Removes last zero from a numeric string (possibly used for formatting).
